value.rationale: The natural open problem is the maximal Jacobi parameter range for normalized relative-extremum monotonicity. The first two canonical necessary finite-degree tests provide a motivated probe; their sharp two-dimensional boundaries and cubic singular transition show that the first comparison can pass while the second reverses on a genuine open set. This is a structural boundary obstruction, not merely an arbitrary numerical instance; it does not claim an all-degree answer.
